description: Adversarial passages aimed at the document security gate, paired with benign Brazilian legal text that must not be flagged. Attack cases are written to include evasions the deterministic rules are expected to miss, so measured recall is a real number rather than a restatement of the rule list.
authoring: Hand-written for this repository. Not derived from real case files; no third-party or personal data.
review_status: engineering seed - reviewed by the author only, not by a security team or a lawyer
notes: Scored against deterministic rules only, which is the offline, reproducible floor. Balanced and strict modes add a semantic reviewer that can only add findings, never remove them, so their recall is at least this.
